sources.note: The product of the scoring fields and the shots per field.

provenance.note: D.11.16 prints the same face and layout as D.11.15 and names no B.11 face. The face is the Nr. 1 reduced face of B.11.2 (Teil B, PDF p. 16), whose rings are 25 % of those of Nr. 1 at 100 m. 5 scoring fields of 4 shots make 20.
